newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cable seen supported at $1.66.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cable seen supported at $1.66.

text.p: Sterling will find support at $1.66 after crashing down to a three-week low early in European trading, technical analysts said.
The pound tumbled as much as two pfennigs from its session's highs against the mark in cable's wake, but is expected to find congestive support about 3.05, they said.
"We are still bullish about sterling but we are more bullish about the dollar, so we expect cable to remain under pressure," said Brian Kiely, treasury technician at Royal Bank of Scotland.
Cable set $1.6624, its lowest since July 2. It was at $1.6715/25 at 0745 GMT from $1.6730/40 late Thursday in Europe.
